description: Illustrative ANCFZ revision-2 POC catalog. The actual published SQL seed is infra/bootstrap/seed-sara-purchase.sql; for every supported intent only passport and Emirates ID are accepted as purchase documents. OCR from Azure Document Intelligence supplies the invoice billing name.

intents.name: Start a Company
intents.description: Help a new business owner choose a company structure, business activity, visa allocation and workspace, and optionally prepare a verified enquiry or quotation. A sandbox purchase requires a verified quote, configured document receipt, separate explicit consent and independent payment verification.
examplePhrases: I want to start a company

requirements.label: What will the company do?
requirements.hint: Ask only if not already supplied.

requirements.label: How many shareholders?
requirements.hint: Useful for FZE vs FZC structure.

requirements.label: How many visas will be needed?
requirements.hint: Ask after customer needs a visa-inclusive package comparison or quote.

requirements.label: What workspace do you prefer?
requirements.hint: Flexi-desk/shared office/private office; confirm actual package inclusions.

requirements.label: Which email should receive the enquiry?
requirements.hint: Only collect as part of a specifically consented lead; OTP identity handled outside model.

note: Document uploads are allowed after selecting any purchase-enabled intent; payment remains restricted to tickets with independently verified quotations, consent and OTP. No synthetic company-application form or document pack is required. Uploaded IDs must be synthetic on localhost HTTP; a parsed name is not identity verification. Existing tickets remain pinned to their old catalog.
